reviews.review:
Some background context: I was an operator in real life for 10 years. Proof → imgur.com/a/2FUqBSz

This game ain’t it, lil bro. This is one of those cases where the dev is doing stuff but doesn’t understand why.

1. Tilted rifles with VR stock
With a perfectly set up VR stock, the rifles are on a tilt. This means the dev intentionally did this because they think it’s “tactical” or whatever. A lot of devs will model this but don’t actually know why it happens — it happens because of how the stock interacts with your shoulder and the plate carrier. There’s nothing tactical about this in the slightest; the gun just does that.
It’s improper, and most soldiers just don’t bother to compensate for it, so just let it happen. This is a game — get rid of it.

2. Floaty gun handling
The guns are really floaty. This is probably done to simulate weight, but it just doesn’t work — it’s a stupid feature and makes it so you can’t do snapshots, letting the crims get shots off before you can, as they will typically fire the moment they can see you.
Operators can hold guns to their shoulder indefinitely — they really aren’t heavy objects if you use them for a living. They are an extension of your body, and in-game they move in unnatural ways that just don’t make sense.

3. Unrealistic shooting and recoil
The shooting is really inaccurate. The recoil gives off the impression of an amateur shooter — you are fighting with the weapon, which goes against marksman principles.
I suspect the dev went to a range, thought “okay, this is what it’s like for everyone,” and then added it to the game.

4. Misuse of the C-clamp grip
Operators don’t use the over-exaggerated C-clamp, especially not the thumb-over-top-rail C-clamp. They may appear to do it in recruiting videos and marketing material, but in real life it’s just not done.
It was designed for competition shooting. It’s extremely tiring to do in a real-world situation.

5. Lack of menu navigation
There are no options or menu. If I go to training or a mission, I need to close the game and restart it in order to go back to the main menu.

6. Unfair criticism for using force
The woman berates you for shooting any criminal, regardless of what they are doing or what threat they pose.

7. Door and breaching issues
The NPCs stand behind doors too much, and about 90% of the doors are locked. This means you need to shotgun-breach them open, which leads to unintentionally shooting NPCs a lot.

8. NPC glitches blamed on the player
The NPCs ending themselves in glitchy ways is somehow your fault, and you get berated for it. 

9. too many doors are locked its just irritating 



in conclusion this game needs A LOT of work and is very "far from Ready or not VR"
reviews.developer_response:
First off, thank you for your service. I very much appreciate you as well as the time you took to give a thorough review. I hope I can help clear up some things in the following. Before going thru each one keep in mind this is early access and definitely not a finished project. My main focus in this game is to give you a Swat/Ready Or Not inspired experience in vr but I totally get I will have hard time living up to those standards as they are great crafted experiences.

1. So the game doesn't support gun stocks quite yet that is planned for the next update actually. There was no intentional tilting or something and is not a "tactical" design. In the future there will be a menu like other games where you can adjust the guns rotation for precise gun stock calibration. Also the hand positions will be adjusted as they are on the quest version of the game so it will help with this as well providing less adjustment for gun stocks.

2. Gun weight, I added gun weight in as a feature request from players however I will make this a toggable option to suite other players needs. I totally get it. This is a classic issue of making some players happy while distressing others.

3. The physical recoil that is, I would agree a bit excessive at times just a preference. I mean the gun kicks back and up like a gun naturally does and slightly side to side. I've pondered letting players adjust the global recoil to suit what they think is good because some people love it and some people hate it. 

4. Thats fair, I honestly dont have much to say on this one. 

5. So steam kind of makes this a pain. If you are using quest link, just press the left meta menu button to open the in-game menu. If you are using steamvr hold the a button for 2 or 3 seconds on your right controller depending on device this may be different and it will open a menu telling you what to press to get back to the base, restart the mission, or quit.

6. Fair enough, she probably should be fired. If the gun is at their hip make sure to try and make them surrender with your right thumbstick up then you can get them to get on their knees with your right thumbstick down before shooting. The goal of the game is to try and not just kill kill kill like other games and instead have ai that will surrender. The ai has been developed throughly to have completely random personalities so you never know who's going to be good and throw the gun or whos going to be bad and throw a bullet. If the gun comes up take em out obviously you know this. Im open to feedback on where this can improve feel free to join my discord.


7. Make sure, as im sure you know to angle the shotgun quite a bit. If you shoot the lock straight on the pellets go thru the door and may hurt a civilian. 

8. So one of two situations going on here:
There are hostages and there are ai that will end themselves as you put it. The enemies with hostages have a couple different scenarios one of them being to off the hostage after a random time so you gotta be quick. If there is a suspect thinking about offing themselves you gotta try and get them to surrender by one of the following:
- yell at them
- taze them
- punch them
- or if absolutely necessary you can shoot the pistol out their hand 

9. Thats fair its random but I can change the variables to make it less often.

Im sorry your first experience with Split Second wasnt desirable but hopefully this helps and you can enjoy it a little more! As stated before feel free to join the discord if you are on discord and I dont mind accepting more feedback or giving more tips on mechanics of the game. 

Take care!
